units.rawText: And my job is to wave a magic wand and bring these mythical worlds to life before their eyes—

spans.text: Whenever you finish telling them a story, you have the same satisfied smile on your face.

units.rawText: This... I've never noticed. If that's so...

spans.text: This... I've never noticed. If that's so...

spans.text: Not at all. You'll allow me to be embarrassed for a little, won't you, Professor.

units.rawText: You've told me yourself that I get to be a little childish around you. Don't go back on your word.

units.rawText: Of course.
units.displayText: Of course.

units.displayText: Acting like a spoiled child... is certainly a different experience.

units.rawText: Do you ever reminisce of times like those, Professor? You know, it's fine to not want to be an "adult" at times.
